Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?

Yes — a damaged or defective item is handled differently from a normal return. Regular returns and exchanges aren’t accepted because all Bellesa products are final sale, but if an item arrived damaged or has a product flaw, we handle that through our damage/defect process. If you want, tell me whether the damage happened in shipping or to the product itself.
